{{Quote|I was looking for a fabled artifact. The Force crystal of Naga Sadow or the Journals of Ood Bnar or maybe just a really well-made bantha burger. I forget what it was. But after searching crate after crate after crate for hours and days and weeks, I found nothing. Nothing!! I finally gave up and retired.|[[Riyan Kiner]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 1|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Force crystal of Naga Sadow''' was a [[force crystal]] that presumably belonged to [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who ruled the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|122|Sadow, Naga}}</ref> Although the existence of the Force crystal of Naga Sadow was debated by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was still sought by treasure hunters. The explorer [[Riyan Kiner]] became utterly insane after spending his life looking for this fabled artifact.<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />
